h1.en: Electric 40 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Camshaft

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Electric 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does list Output Capacity 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的电动40型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行标出了理论输送量21 m³/h和最大出口压力23 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft. Subject: Nockenwelle ani. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Electric 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. This Electric 40 Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already lists. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. It is not a measured stroke for Electric 40 Concrete Pump. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance entries, not from the frame and not from a different pump.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft。画面主体：Nockenwelle ani。河北品锦机械没有在邢台的电动40型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。另一份易损件清单用外径列出活塞和摆臂类替换件。如果画面里能看到活塞或阀，那只是这一帧的主体。

body.en: The row does list Output Capacity 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. The frame “Crane (machine)” shows Tower crane cabin and adds no stroke figure. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Subject: Tower crane cabin. Output Capacity 21 m³/h.
body.zh: 这一行标出了理论输送量21 m³/h和最大出口压力23 MPa。电动40型混凝土泵这一行不会把那些名称变成扭矩、小时间隔，或这一行没有写出的材料牌号。管路长度仍要读这个型号自己的距离格，不读这一帧，也不读另一台泵。

body.en: A piston displaces concrete into the line. a squeeze pump compresses a hose. The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa.
body.zh: 画面「Crane (machine)」的主体是塔式起重机 cabin，也没有补上行程数字。细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m。

question.en: Does Electric 40 Concrete Pump list a piston stroke?
question.zh: 电动40型混凝土泵标出了活塞行程吗？

answer.en: No. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft.
answer.zh: 没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 那标出了什么工作参数？

answer.en: Output Capacity 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft.
answer.zh: 理论输送量21 m³/h，最大出口压力23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft.
answer.zh: 没有。小时、扭矩和价格都没有标出。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camshaft画面里印出的数字。
